purpose: Typewriter 打字机; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandTypewriter](../../lib/src/components/typewriter.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: Rendered text and optional onDone notification for a non-empty completed run.
interface.state_model: Owns a grapheme-based reveal position and generation-bound timer. play=false or reduced motion shows complete content; it is not a pause control. Text/span, trigger, speed or play changes restart the run.
interface.events: Non-empty animated runs call onDone once on completion. Immediate completion queues a generation-checked post-frame notification. Empty text emits no completion notification.
interface.composition: Plain/rich text and builder(text, visible-prefix renderer) share one grapheme timeline. Builder owns layout; Typewriter owns timing and full-text semantics, and never walks widget trees.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Cancels its owned timer on restart/disposal; queued completion checks the current generation. Explicit TextSpan recognizers remain caller-owned.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.given: Plain or rich text with explicit strutStyle and text scaling
scenarios.when: Render or rebuild with changed text scale
scenarios.then: Line metrics follow caller strut configuration; explicit span styles and text are preserved. Omitted strut retains Flutter default layout.
